visualReview.notes: Inspected all11 current portable frames including a compact1024×640 summary. Four octagonal minarets surround the open court, five pale ochre prayer-hall domes stand behind the blue/cream pointed west iwan, and a smaller east dome tops the through gateway. Rose masonry, red paving, green rectangular pool, two separate eastern lightwells and the small mapped court pavilion remain distinct. Corrected an upper iwan collision with the central dome support by shortening the estimated blind recess to4.2 m; the continuous back screen now sits ahead of the support. Shaft tile fields follow their actual octagonal faces, friezes are clipped at openings and the gateway stays clear. Fine floral tilework, calligraphy, muqarnas, people and furnished interiors are omitted.

Six existing shared256² stucco, lime plaster, raw limestone, mosaic tile, brick and plain wood graphs serve seven emitted roles; opaque static green basin water uses a palette material. All graph reads occur once; eviction disposes geometry and restores host ground. No embedded images, copied photographs, unique tile atlas or invented lettering. Metric UVs and linear tints preserve material scale and brightness. The raw main footprint and selected mapped parts are covered; nine nearby buildings stay host content. Shared flat placement verifies pose and cutout, not a surveyed grade.
